source_title: Lemon Squeezy Vs Gumroad Which Platform Is Right For You

snippets.snippet_text: "Lemon Squeezy excels in handling subscriptions, abandoned carts, and email marketing but lacks a marketplace for additional exposure. Gumroad offers more visibility through its marketplace and robust community features, while also supporting a range of product types, including physical goods."
"Lemon Squeezy charges lower transaction fees but has more variables (e.g., international payments). Gumroad's 10% flat fee simplifies pricing but can add up for high-ticket items."
